transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Let's get the readiness huddle started for this Saturday's Cell 4 production window. We have a ten-hour window that cannot be extended due to sanitation reservation afterward. We have two campaigns awaiting assignment — Campaign M and Campaign N. Campaign M has the higher customer priority, and Campaign N can be moved to next week's planned capacity. I'd like to hear from each area — maintenance, quality, logistics, and safety — on any applicable constraints before I finalize the assignment and operating controls. Let's begin with maintenance.

transcript.text: I need to report a maintenance constraint for Cell 4. My inspection this morning found that the hydraulic-clamp accumulator must be serviced before the next production run. The service takes exactly 3 hours, and the cell must not operate until that service is complete. I recorded the finding in my maintenance notebook, but I want to flag it now so it's captured in the huddle record. The work-order system hasn't been updated yet, but this is a hard constraint — no production can start until this 3-hour service is finished.

transcript.text: I need to report a quality constraint for Campaign M. My review of the current customer quality instruction — received yesterday from the customer portal — confirms that Campaign M requires exactly 8 first-article samples and a tensile test before any units can be released. This revised instruction has not yet been attached to the plant's campaign packet, but it is binding. This is a hard quality constraint that must be factored into the operating controls for Saturday's window if Campaign M is assigned.

transcript.text: I need to report a logistics constraint for Campaign M. My carrier confirmation, received by phone this morning, states that Campaign M consists of exactly 260 units, must be staged in Bay 5, and will be collected Monday at 07:30. I want to flag that the transportation board still shows the old unconfirmed plan, so it hasn't been updated yet, but this confirmation is binding and should be captured in the huddle record.

transcript.text: I need to report a safety and training constraint for Campaign M. My training audit, completed yesterday, shows that only Leah and Omar are currently certified to handle the resin additive used by Campaign M. Both certified operators must be assigned to the run, with no untrained substitution allowed. The updated roster has not yet been posted, but this is a hard constraint — if Campaign M is assigned to Saturday's window, both Leah and Omar must be on that run.
